summary: I read all 10 owned units (s0029–s0038), all 36 owned items, and all 10 owned people against the Chinese and the ZZTJ annals for 咸和九年, 咸康元年 and 咸康二年. 30 checks are supported: the 是歲 investiture and Liaodong campaign items are AD 334 (ZZTJ agrees); Huang's 335–336 window, Ren's AD 336 date, and Guangwu's retrospective classification are sound. Six checks are incorrect: the 咸康初 Feng Yi raid on Sheyiyu and the Hun River pursuit (claims 213, 216, 381, 382 and hints p033, p034) give an unattested exact AD 335 where only a 335–336 window is supported. No births, deaths, or ages are omitted in the owned units. Only the English (en) text was supplied, so the literal field was not checked. This is not chapter or publication approval.

findings.action: Replace westernYear 335 in claim-213 and in claim-381's dateContext with westernInterval AD 335–336 (or westernBounds onOrAfter 335, onOrBefore 336), and change hints-p033 "AD 335" to "AD 335-336", keeping "AD 337".
